title: Bigg Boss Telugu: Agnipariksha
plot_overview: Bigg Boss Agnipariksha is a digital pre-show of Bigg Boss 9 Telugu and a spin-off of the Indian reality television show Bigg Boss. The pre-show involves selecting commoner contestants for the main show.
